verdict.rationale: No item explicitly documents a free tier or trial. The docs only imply one: analytics are reserved for 'owners of public notebooks with paid subscriptions', which suggests non-paid users can also own and use notebooks, and usage is metered by 'AI limits' that users can run out of. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a free tier or trial, its quotas (notebooks, sources, chats, Audio/Video Overviews), which features are paywalled, and independent hands-on reports of meaningful use without paying.
